title: A Red Squirrel's Route From Food to Trees
caption:
A RED SQUIRREL'S DAILY ROUTE. Real squirrels filmed in different woodlands and cities. #WildVox #RedSquirrel #Wildlife

narration_timeline.text: On a stump, a red squirrel handles food while balancing above the ground.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic footage: Red Squirrel 'Nutkin' - Seen at Forest How, Eskdale, Cumbria - North West England.webm

narration_timeline.text: Nearby in another recording, a squirrel investigates walnuts scattered on the wood.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic footage: The Great Walnut Disaster.webm

narration_timeline.text: Other red squirrels pause on a city ledge and among branches, watching their surroundings.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic footage: Red Squirrel in Berlin.webm and Ekorre rädselljud? Red squirrel fear noise?.webm

narration_timeline.text: Two separately filmed squirrels travel around park trees, using the trunks and branches as pathways.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic footage: 2022-01-21 LJUBLJANA Krajinski park Tivoli RODENTIA Sciurus vulgaris NAVADNA VEVERICA.webm and 2021-12-10 LJUBLJANA Krajinski park Tivoli RODENTIA Sciurus vulgaris NAVADNA VEVERICA.webm

narration_timeline.text: An English red squirrel pauses in a different tree, taking in the scene.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic footage: Red squirrel (Sciurus vulgaris) in England.webm

narration_timeline.text: Finally, one climbs a trunk, connecting the search for food with the movement between trees.
